text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 10, 2025) for 2558 Eglinton Avenue West.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (April 10, 2025) for 2558 Eglinton Avenue West, Folder Number 25 142594 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to June 1, 2026 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
